release_note_review.reason: A new permission setting for Write, Edit, and NotebookEdit. Headless selects --permission-mode plan with Read, Glob, and Grep and has no write tool.

release_note_review.surface: claude -p exiting 0 with no output when startup failed
release_note_review.reason: The note makes a startup failure print its error and exit 1 instead of exiting 0 silently. The adapter already requires a terminal result frame and fails closed without one, so this makes the provider failure explicit without adding a stream field or a mapped operation.

release_note_review.surface: prompts containing tags such as bash-stdout or local-command-stdout not acknowledged to a local stream-json host
release_note_review.reason: Headless sends text input over stream-json. The fix restores the existing acknowledgement for prompts carrying those tags. It adds no event type and no field.

release_note_review.surface: a settings file excluded with --setting-sources still supplying some settings
release_note_review.reason: Headless passes --setting-sources user,project,local. The note makes the already-mapped exclusion actually apply to auto mode rules and saved consents. A fix that makes an already-mapped flag apply is a compatible extension, not a behavior revision. The selected permission mode stays plan.
Headless does not select compaction. The measured PreToolUse, prompt-hook, rewrite, and Stop decisions are unchanged; this bounds hook output size.

release_note_review.surface: hooks matching Bash on Monitor-started commands; Bash and shell fixes
release_note_review.reason: Headless tools stay Read, Glob, and Grep; no Bash or Monitor call is admitted.

release_note_review.surface: memory use in long headless and SDK turns that run many subagents
release_note_review.reason: Headless does not admit the Agent tool, so no subagent tool result is retained on this route. No selected field or lifecycle step changes.

release_note_review.surface: TLS, MCP sign-in, gateway, cloud session, Remote Control, VS Code, and model-catalogue notes
release_note_review.reason: Those notes sit outside the fixed read-only tool set, the strict empty MCP config, the local subscription command, and the stream-json field set.

release_note_review.surface: npm 2.1.315 with no public tag or release
release_note_review.reason: The public repository has no v2.1.315 tag or release, so no provider note exists to review. Identity rests on current npm metadata, the integrity-checked tarballs, the per-file tree delta, and the selected static surfaces.
The hop adds only --gateway-json, an auth-login presentation flag. Neither route passes it and neither authenticates.

The executables grow by about 30 MiB of embedded tool-runner text. The selected CLI option texts, stream-json help, markers, decision literals, init construction, and safe-mode isolation are unchanged, and no stream-json subtype is added.
A new environment switch that turns the ultrathink keyword off. Swallowtail does not set it and keywords are prompt text, not a mapped stream field.

release_note_review.surface: Grep and Glob hang when the search process does not exit after its timeout
release_note_review.reason: Grep and Glob are in the headless tool set. The note stops a hung search from never returning. It changes neither the tool result shape nor the stream-json fields; route cancellation stays process force_stop.

release_note_review.surface: shell commands left running when Claude Code exits by itself
release_note_review.reason: Headless admits no shell tool and cancellation remains process force_stop. The provider now reaps its own shell children on self-exit; the adapter's cleanup contract is unchanged.

release_note_review.surface: PowerShell hooks not blocking on exit code 2, and other hook execution fixes
release_note_review.reason: The measured PreToolUse deny, prompt-hook block, rewrite recheck, and Stop reentry decisions stay. A hook that previously failed to block now blocks, which applies the already-mapped rule rather than adding a new one.

release_note_review.surface: claude -p text output not naming why auto mode stopped a turn
release_note_review.reason: Headless selects --permission-mode plan, not auto mode, and admits no background agent.
No Agent tool is admitted and no subagent effort is selected.

release_note_review.surface: fast-mode deprecation, gateway budgets, cloud, Claude Tag, and VS Code notes
release_note_review.reason: Those notes sit outside the local subscription stream-json command and the selected tool set.
